integrity: The proof reconstructs the published facet constants, translates them by the singleton baseline, bounds every fragmented collision offset by a two-parameter extremal function, proves a strict normalized-density gap for every proper nonsingleton facet, and matches the resulting lower bound with an all-center upper bound from singleton facets. Finite exact-arithmetic enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to m,n>=3 and to the explicit Bottman--Poliakova realization. It does not cover boundary equality cases, the geometrically different shuffle realization, arbitrary affine realizations, circumradii, or John ellipsoids. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent generic Chebyshev-center observation under different terminology.
title: Singleton collision facets determine the inball of the Bottman–Poliakova constrainahedron
